context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkout bug is fixed. Key testids: product-add-button-{slug}, cart-checkout-button, cart-checkout-newtab-note, cart-checkout-newtab-link, cart-subtotal. For iframe testing use page.wait_for_event('popup') + context.wait_for_event('page') BEFORE clicking checkout; Chromium requires the listener armed first. Always release sessions you create via POST /api/payments/release/{sid}. If a run leaves orphaned reservations the next test gets 409 — can bulk-clear via Mongo: db.payment_transactions.update_many({status:'initiated'},{$set:{status:'expired',payment_status:'expired'}}). Stripe shows adaptive SGD pricing in sandbox; look for CA$ option as the authoritative amount.
rca of the issue: RCA: Stripe Checkout embeds frame-busting (X-Frame-Options/CSP) that refuses to render inside a cross-origin parent iframe (the Emergent editor preview). The redirect inside the preview iframe therefore landed on checkout.stripe.com but Stripe only painted its grey skeleton and never bootstrapped the form, matching the user's screenshot. Fix in /app/frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.js checkout(): detect iframe context via window.self === window.top; if top-level, same-tab navigate; if iframed, window.open(url,'_blank') (fallback window.top.location.href), and surface cart-checkout-newtab-note + cart-checkout-newtab-link so the user can click through manually if the popup is blocked. Verified both branches work.
